difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a Nagata algebraic space X over a scheme S, the normalization nu : X^nu -> X is a finite morphism (source lines 10649-10653). The proof notes that Nagata implies locally Noetherian, so that the definition of the normalization applies, and then uses the explicit construction of X^nu to reduce the finiteness statement to the case of schemes, where it is a known lemma.
